page.layout: Running head at top: page number 154 and the title "ARCHELOGIÆ CAP. XXVII." (right of the number). One text column at right, two paragraphs. Left margin: a note beside the first two lines ("Membra corporis principalia:"), then four notes below it, beside the blank lower text area ("Cerebrum", "Spiritus a-nimalis.", "Imago objecti intelligibilis.").; One text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Below the text, at the right, the catchword "Nullus". Right edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

page.notes: The four left-margin notes stand beside the blank lower part of the text area, after the last printed line, so they are placed at the end of the second paragraph. "Cerebrum" is set in bold type. The "ob-" and "intel-" hyphens in the last note are printed hyphens at line ends. Short specks in the left margin beside the lines "Continens" and "Formale" are ink marks, not text. The reading of the margin note "Imago ob-jecti memo-ria" is partly worn; the last word is read as "ria,.." with some doubt.
